title: Among users who have commented on posts with a view count below 1000, find
question: Among users who have commented on posts with a view count below 1000, find the user with the highest reputation and return only the most recently awarded badge for this user, including the badge name and the award date, based on the latest award date in descending order.

prediction.sql:
WITH EligibleUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN comments c ON u.XCL_052 = c.XCL_010
    INNER JOIN posts p ON c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
    WHERE p.XCL_030 < 1000
),
TopUser AS (
    SELECT eu.user_id
    FROM EligibleUsers eu
    INNER JOIN users u ON eu.user_id = u.XCL_052
    ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT b.XCL_003, b.XCL_004
FROM badges b
INNER JOIN TopUser tu ON b.XCL_002 = tu.user_id
ORDER BY b.XCL_004 DESC
LIMIT 1
